name: MoneyBox
description:
## About MoneyBox

MoneyBox is a personal finance tracker that helps you see where your money goes, set savings goals, and stay on budget — without the clutter of a full banking app.

### Smart savings goals

Set targets for trips, emergencies, or big purchases and watch your progress with clear visual charts.

### Expense tracking

Log spending by category, spot patterns early, and keep daily habits honest.

### Clean reporting

Monthly summaries and trend views that make sense at a glance — no spreadsheet required.

hero.title: Your money, finally organised.
hero.subtitle: A personal finance tracker with budgets, goals, and clean reporting — built to keep saving simple and visible every day.

features.title: Smart Savings Goals
features.description: Set targets for anything — emergencies, travel, or big purchases — and track progress with motivating visual charts.

features.title: Expense Tracking
features.description: Log spending by category, spot patterns early, and keep daily habits honest without drowning in spreadsheets.

features.title: Budget Overview
features.description: See income vs. outgo at a glance with monthly summaries that stay readable on mobile.

features.title: Clean Reporting
features.description: Trend views and category breakdowns designed for quick check-ins — not end-of-month archaeology.

features.title: Daily Reminders
features.description: Gentle nudges to log expenses and review goals so the app works with your routine, not against it.

features.title: Private by Design
features.description: Your finances stay on your device. No ads, no data resale — just a tool that respects your numbers.

faq.question: Is MoneyBox free?
faq.answer: MoneyBox is a live product from Baseet Studio. Download links and pricing are available on the Android build; iOS availability is coming soon.

faq.question: Does it connect to my bank?
faq.answer: MoneyBox focuses on manual tracking and goal setting — simple, private, and fully under your control.

faq.question: Where is my data stored?
faq.answer: Your data stays on your device. We do not sell or share your financial information.
